svg.text: Details forms — visual design (ImGui default dark; every element below is one ImGui call — see the design's §2 table)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
PENDING (> 1 s): hourglass, amber; the new value shows
REFUSED / LOST: red ✗ in the status slot + faint red row;
value back to the real one; tooltip = the reason;
click ✗ to clear; + a sticky notification (panel D)
INVALID INPUT (local, before any send): red frame +
the reason under the field, visible while typing;
nothing is committed until it is valid
AUTHORED ≠ TYPE: reset arrow (blue) — click resets
to the type's value; tooltip: "Type 0.50 — reset"
NOT ALLOWED FOR THIS SEAT: row disabled + lock;
ROW ANATOMY: label | control (fills) | status slot (18 px, fixed)
the slot is always reserved, so a mark never moves the layout;
one mark at a time: ✗ > ⌛ > lock > reset
Unit — fields common to all 3; a tick sets one value for all
Ticked ⇒ editable; Enter writes all 3, ONE undo step.
A differing checkbox shows ▬ (drawn by hand).
whole form inside BeginDisabled; no marks, no pickers
Orders changed on node 2 (Instructor) while you edited
CONFLICT: an amber bar at the top of the committing form
Sticky notifications — top-right of the main window,
newest on top, stay until dismissed (R-4127)
while you were editing Bravo's plan
+ 2 more… (stack shows 3; the Messages panel keeps the history)
